title: Application of Boston Gas Company for approval of a 334 Day Transportation Agreement pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 94 and 220 CMR 5.03, with Hebrew Rehabilitation Center for Aged.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: This pricing structure is in accordance with the Department's standard and the Department, therefore, Approves the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms to be purchased under the Agreement are competitiively sensitive, and therefore, Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners Besser, Connelly, Keating, Vasington and Sullivan. GC 99-20.
